1.

Lord Jesus, may we rejoice In Thy love more and more, And highly praise the favour Which Thou dost so richly give us. If there is no other subject For the praise of the redeemed once, O, may we then not on earth Sing any other song.

2.

Our sins hast Thou borne, All defects dost Thou heal, And we may God’s love’s rays In Thy countenance behold now. Who is he that will condemn, When Thou sayest: “Go in peace”! Thou with grace and power dost crown us Specially for each special conflict.

3.

Help us without anxiety to be, Thyself wilt care for all, Thou who givest what we need And thereover a thousandfold! Nothing, nothing shall fail us, Need and grace indeed thus follow, That in all things and for all things We must ever thank Thee.
